items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I was wondering, Will, if you have a couple minutes to talk yet about your brother Earl.

ctx.x: But they're trying to play up all that stuff now. Like they're trying to lure tourists here, I noticed in the people. They're trying to get some sort of program. And I saw it today, where they're going to try and have some kind of big hotel. Well they plan on going to hotel on the late front. Anyway. They're going to have activities and things out there. I don't know. Well, you got to spend money to make it.

I was wondering, Will, if you have a couple minutes to talk yet about your brother Earl. I've never met him. I hope we'll get to talk to him someday. But in case we don't for a while, if you could. Was he older, younger than you? No, Earl's next to me. Just about two years younger.
You're the oldest. You haven't worked there in September.
